concepts.label: material discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

unit_attributes.statement: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

concepts.label: material discrepancy explanation
concepts.definition: Requirement for an applicant to explain material discrepancies between names across application, nationality evidence, and identity evidence.
concepts.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

unit_attributes.object_quote: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.statement: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.

concepts.label: documentation of material discrepancies
concepts.definition: Acceptable documentation required to substantiate material name discrepancies on a passport application.
concepts.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section

unit_attributes.choice_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); certificates of naturalization; marriage certificates; documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or documentation of customary usage
unit_attributes.logic_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)). Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25): (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.object_quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity

qualifications.statement: An exception applies for married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

unit_attributes.statement: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more acceptable documents (name change orders, divorce decrees, certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage), except for married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

concepts.label: review of name change evidence
concepts.definition: Mandatory inspection of material name change evidence for counterfeiting or alteration.
concepts.quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

unit_attributes.statement: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration.

concepts.label: previous name usage
concepts.definition: Restriction on continuing to use a previous name following a material name change.
concepts.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

unit_attributes.logic_text: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
unit_attributes.object_quote: a previous name after a material name change
unit_attributes.object: a previous name after a material name change

qualifications.statement: The applicant is permitted to continue using the previous name if the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.

unit_attributes.statement: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.

concepts.label: identity evidence requirement
concepts.definition: Possibility of requiring identity evidence under federal regulations to determine the name that best identifies an applicant.
concepts.quote: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

unit_attributes.statement: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant, as the applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.

concepts.label: application suspension for updated ID
concepts.definition: Duty to suspend a DS-11 application when a material name change occurred over one year prior and ID remains unupdated.
concepts.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

typed_values.name: material name change timing threshold
typed_values.quote: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11

concepts.label: emergency limited-validity passport issuance
concepts.definition: Permission to issue a limited-validity passport in the requested name when urgent travel prevents obtaining acceptable updated ID.
concepts.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name

typed_values.name: material name change timing threshold

qualifications.statement: Applies when the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 without updating ID, and there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.

concepts.label: applicant ID change documentation need
concepts.definition: Practical necessity of name change documentation for an applicant to update ID.
concepts.quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

unit_attributes.object_quote: the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID
unit_attributes.object: the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID

concepts.label: notation of name change documentation
concepts.definition: Duty to fully notate name change documentation before returning it to the applicant with an IRL.
concepts.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)

qualifications.statement: Notation must occur prior to returning the documentation, including stating that it was seen and returned, to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

unit_attributes.statement: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

concepts.label: exemption from updated ID submission
concepts.definition: Exemption from submitting ID in the new name for applicants with recent name changes.
concepts.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

concepts.label: submission of name change documentation
concepts.definition: Duty to submit name change documentation if ID has not yet been changed following a recent material name change.
concepts.quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
